blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow–inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies.
In this paper, we propose MedPrune , an efficient MED ical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically PRUNE s both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency.
Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning–driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity.
Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness. 1 1 1 Source code and data are provided in the supplementary material and will be released upon acceptance.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The integration of MLLMs into medicine has advanced automated diagnostic support, with Med-MLLMs showing strong capabilities in multimodal tasks Zou and Yin (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Wang et al. (2026) .
However, as the focus shifts from controlled benchmarks to real-world clinical deployment, a fundamental limitation emerges from the inherently multi-specialty and collaborative nature of medicine Chen et al. (2025b) ; Fan et al. (2025) .
A single LLM-based model cannot capture the deep expertise of fields, and its performance deteriorates on complex cases requiring cross-department reasoning Zhu et al. (2025) ; Lin et al. (2026) .

blocks.en:
Previous works for medical VQA can be broadly categorized into three paradigms: (1) Training-free : single-agent prompting methods such as specialized chain-of-thought (CoT) Wei et al. (2022) and RAG Xia et al. (2024b) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Wu et al. (2026b) , aim to improve reasoning without model parameters updates.
While these methods avoid costly fine-tuning and can incorporate external knowledge, they remain susceptible to medical hallucinations when the domain knowledge is insufficient Zhu et al. (2025) ; Kim et al. (2025) .
(2) Training-intensive : these methods are including supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning techniques, directly optimize model parameters on medical data Elmekki et al. (2025) ; Aydın et al. (2026) . While they achieve stronger modality alignment and improved factual grounding within a unified representation space, they require substantial volumes of high-quality annotated medical data and expensive computational resource Dong et al. (2025) ; Jiang et al. (2026) .
(3) Multi-agent Collaboration : these works have recently emerged as a flexible paradigm that circumvents the need for model fine-tuning Chen et al. (2025a) ; Du et al. (2026) .
By orchestrating multiple MLLMs-based agents to mimic clinical multi-departmental collaboration, they can gather different expert opinions to reach a consensus diagnosis Zhu et al. (2025) .
Although this approach improves diagnostic coverage and reduces dependency on any single model, existing implementations often rely on static, predefined interaction workflows Xia et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2025c) .
Such rigidity fails to capture the dynamic, case-adaptive nature of real-world clinical consultations, while token consumption escalates rapidly as more agents and discussion rounds are involved Wu et al. (2026a) ; Yoon et al. (2026) .
Concurrently, several adaptive topology optimization methods have emerged to mitigate such overhead by either pruning or generating redundant agents or communication edges based on states via learnable graph structures Shao et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2026) , yet their effectiveness in medical multimodal reasoning remains unexplored; see Fig. 1 .

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce a MED ical multimodal multi-agent PRUNING framework, named MedPrune , that formalizes medical diagnosis as a dynamic evolutionary graph learning over heterogeneous multi-departmental collaboration.
Our main contributions are summarized below: • Heterogeneous Node Sparsification: Existing multi-agent medical systems typically communicate with all departments agents, thereby compelling models to allocate computational resources to clinically irrelevant specialties Xia et al. (2025a) ; Du et al. (2026) .
To address this, we propose a heterogeneous node sparsification that selectively prunes diagnostically irrelevant specialist nodes by learning task-adaptive inter-departmental communication graph.
Specifically, we parameterize the heterogeneous graph with learnable soft adjacency matrices and optimize them via reinforcement learning using task performance as the reward signal.
Then, pruning nodes with minimal weighted degree along with their incident edges to dynamically assemble a compact team of relevant specialists and eliminate token overhead from the initial round. • Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification: Even after pruning irrelevant agents, redundant communication edges may persist, wasting tokens and propagating hallucinations across departments Zhang et al. (2025) ; Shao et al. (2025) .
Hence, after re-initializing edge weights on the node-sparsified subgraph, we jointly optimize them under a composite objective that maximizes task performance while penalizing topological complexity. This process prunes low-utility edges and retains only the most salient intra- and inter-departmental connections, ensuring that each remaining edge contributes high diagnostic utility.
Two-stage sparsification fundamentally addresses efficiency bottlenecks in multi-agent medical reasoning, achieving high diagnostic performance with drastically reduced token costs.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们引入了一个名为“MedPrune”的医学多模式多剂性PRUNING框架,将医学诊断正式化,作为跨部门协作的动态进化图。
我们的主要贡献概述如下: • 异地结点分解: 现有的多剂医疗系统通常与所有部门的代理通信,从而迫使模型将计算资源分配给临床无关的专科Xia等(2025a); Du等(2026).
为了解决这个问题,我们建议采用不同的节点分泌法,通过学习适应任务和部门间交流图,有选择地推开诊断无关的专家节点。
具体地说,我们用可学习的软接力矩阵参数化了相异的图表,并通过利用任务性能作为奖励信号的强化学习来优化它们.
然后,用最小加权度的节点及其事故边缘,动态地组装一个由相关专家组成的紧凑小组,并去除最初回合的象征性间接费用。 • 异地分裂: 即使在寻找无关紧要的特工后,冗余的通信边缘仍会继续存在,会浪费信物并跨部传播幻觉. 张等 (2025年); 肖等 (2025年).
因此,在重新初始化了节点分层子图上的边重后,我们在一个复合目标下共同优化了它们,该目标既能最大限度地实现任务性能,又能惩罚地形的复杂性. 这个过程会拉出低功用边缘,只保留部门内和部门间最突出的联系,确保每个剩余边缘都贡献出高诊断效用.
两级斯帕氏症从根本上解决了多剂医学推理中的效率瓶颈,实现了高诊断性能并大幅降低象征性成本.

blocks.en:
We evaluate MedPrune on three authoritative medical VQA benchmarks: MIMIC-CXR Johnson et al. (2019) , IU-Xray Demner-Fushman et al. (2016) and OmniMedVQA Hu et al. (2024) under full-set and few-shot training settings.
Our method consistently outperforms strong baselines across training-free, training-intensive, and medical multi-agent systems. Under both training settings, our approach achieves an average performance improvement of 3.65% and a 37.86% boost in token efficiency.
In addition, our method only reduces the average performance by 3.1% under the adversarial attack settings, which greatly proves the robustness of our system.

我们的方法在无培训、训练密集和医疗多代理系统方面,一贯超过强有力的基线。 在两种培训环境中,我们的方法平均提高了3.65%的绩效,提高了37.86%的象征性效率。
此外,我们的方法只在对抗性攻击设置下将平均性能降低3.1%,这极大地证明了我们系统的稳健性.

blocks.en:
Existing approaches can be primarily divided into two paradigms: (1) Training - free Methods. They aim to elicit better reasoning from frozen Med-MLLMs backbones. CoT Wei et al. (2022) decomposes complex clinical questions into intermediate reasoning steps.
Multimodal RAG Xia et al. (2024b) ; Xia et al. (2025b) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Wu et al. (2026b) further supplies external knowledge such as medical literature or electronic health records to ground the model’s response.
(2) Training - intensive Methods. They focus on updating model parameters on domain - specific corpora. SFT He et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2025) ; Gong et al. (2025) aligns Med - MLLMs with medical image–text pairs, enhancing modality fusion and factual grounding. Reinforcement learning works Su et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) further steers generation toward clinician - preferred outputs by optimizing for human - defined reward signals.
While these techniques yield stronger in - distribution results, they demand large - scale and high - quality annotated medical data Mota et al. (2024) ; Matos et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: 2.2 Multimodal Multi-Agent Collaboration
blocks.zh: 2.2 多式联运代理协作

blocks.en:
Research in this area falls into two categories:
(1) Static Collaboration. AdaCoMed Chen et al. (2025a) uses a mixture-of-modality-experts to fuse uni-modal representations and introduces adaptive co-learning coupling experts with a compact model.
MedAgent-Pro Wang et al. (2025c) operationalizes diagnostic protocols by decomposing clinical reasoning into evidence-grounded stages.
(2) Adaptive Evolving Collaboration. Rising VQA complexity exposes limitations of static multi-agent systems, driving dynamic multi-modal collaboration Ranaldi et al. (2025) ; Nie et al. (2026) .
MMedAgent-RL Xia et al. (2025a) uses RL to learn optimal policies among medical agents.
M 3 Prune Shao et al. (2025) is a hierarchical communication graph pruning framework that eliminates redundant edges.
CARE Du et al. (2026) decouples grounding and reasoning via coordinator-guided framework with explicit segmentation evidence.
ARG-Designer Li et al. (2026) reframes topology design as autoregressive graph generation.
However, these methods primarily focus on generic collaboration, lacking specialized designs for heterogeneous medical knowledge.
In this paper, we jointly sparsify nodes and edges over the heterogeneous graph, achieving more efficient evolution rather than surface-level adaptations.

blocks.en:
Within each medical department, some specialist agents contribute little to collaborative reasoning due to varying relevance to the diagnostic question Kim et al. (2024) ; Miao et al. (2026) .
Hence, our method performs node-level pruning on the communication graph at each round, thereby removing medical agents that exhibit minimal contribution.

blocks.en: We evaluate MedPrune on three medical multimodal QA benchmarks covering various body parts (i.e., Chest, Bone, Eyes, and Thyroid) under full-set and few-shot training settings, against four types of strong baselines with Qwen3-VL (8B).
blocks.zh: 我们对MedPrune在全定和少发的训练环境下,对照四类具有Qune3-VL(8B)的强基线,对涵盖身体各部分(即胸、骨、眼和甲状腺)的三种医疗多式质量控制基准进行评估。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 1 , we can observe that: (1) Methodologically, the performance hierarchy reveals a clear progression in reasoning capability. Training - free prompting (SP, CoT) and training - intensive single - agent methods (RAG, LoRA, GRPO) both suffer from limited cross - disciplinary reasoning capacity, with the former being particularly vulnerable to hallucinations Kim et al. (2025) .
Fixed - template systems incur heavy token overhead from static interaction patterns, while adaptive methods achieve only moderate topology refinement and remain suboptimal for medical reasoning. Our MedPrune jointly prunes irrelevant specialist nodes and redundant edges, dynamically tailoring the graph per question, and consistently outperforms all baselines with superior accuracy and token efficiency.
(2) Regardless of backbone generality (general - domain vs. domain - adapted) or scale (7B to 397B), MedPrune consistently achieves superior performance. This robustness stems from its task - driven graph optimization, which is independent of specialized MLLM knowledge, while larger backbones universally improve all methods with more pronounced gains for multi - agent systems, owing to their enhanced multimodal alignment and instruction - following capabilities Luo et al. (2025) .
(3) Regarding training strategy, few-shot training with only 10 samples enables MedPrune to achieve performance comparable to full-set training, particularly with domain-adapted backbones. This stability is attributed to our task-driven graph optimization, which involves no MLLMs’ parameter updates and thus avoids the overfitting and representation disruption that plague training-intensive methods under extreme data scarcity Zhu et al. (2026) .
Consequently, our model reduces data dependency, offering a robust diagnostic performance with high token economy solution for resource-constrained clinical environments.

如表1所示,我们可以看到: (1) 在方法上,业绩等级显示推理能力有明显进步。 培训 -- -- 免费激励(SP、COT)和培训 -- -- 密集的单一代理方法(RAG、LORA、GRPO)都受到有限的交叉纪律推理能力的限制,前者特别容易受到Kim等人的幻觉影响(2025年)。
固定-模板系统从静态相互作用模式中产生沉重的间接费用,而适应方法仅能实现中等程度的地貌修饰,而且对于医学推理来说仍然不尽人意。 我们的MedPrune联合推开无关紧要的专家节点和冗余的边缘,动态地裁剪每个题的图表,并且一贯地超越所有基准,具有更高的准确性和象征性效率。
(2) 不论主干一般(一般-域与域-被调整)或规模(7B至397B),MedPrune一贯达到优等性能. 这种稳健性源于它的任务 -- -- 驱动的图表优化,它独立于专业的MLLM知识,而更大的主干部分则普遍改进所有方法,对多剂系统更显著地有利,因为它们加强了多模式的配合和指导 -- -- 跟随Luo等人的能力(2025年)。
(3) 关于培训战略,只有10个样本的少部分射入式培训使MedPrune能够取得与全套培训相当的成绩,特别是具有适合域的骨干。 这种稳定性归因于我们任务驱动的图表优化,这不涉及MLLMs的参数更新,从而避免了在极其缺乏数据的情况下(2026年)影响训练密集型方法的过度调整和代表干扰。
因此,我们的模型减少了对数据的依赖,为资源紧张的临床环境提供了有力的诊断性能,并提供了高象征性的经济解决方案。

blocks.zh: 4.2 读取研究

blocks.en:
We ablate MedPrune by sequentially removing its core components and report averaged results on Qwen3-VL (8B) and HuatuoGPT-Vision (7B).
In Table 2 , (1) removing NS or ES consistently causes the most substantial performance declines, confirming that pruning irrelevant agents and redundant communication edges is indispensable for focusing computation on high-utility collaboration. It also directly addresses the inefficiencies of static and adaptive multi-agent topologies. (2) Removing the nuclear norm (w/o norm) causes moderate drops, confirming that low - rank priors aid compact topology.
Ablating progressive pruning (w/o PP) results in smaller declines, confirming that a constant ratio yields strong baselines, while progressive pruning further refines MedPrune ’s performance edge.
Ablating department selection (w/o DS) causes only minor performance drop, indicating fixed departments suffice for promising results, while selection accelerates convergence via better initialization.

blocks.en: We present MedPrune , a topology - efficient multi - agent collaborative framework for medical multimodal VQA. To reduce redundant communication, we introduce heterogeneous node pruning that removes clinically irrelevant specialists, and heterogeneous edge pruning that retains diagnostically significant connections. Extensive experiments on medical VQA benchmarks show MedPrune consistently achieves superior diagnostic performance and token efficiency.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了MedPrune,这是一个医疗多模式VQA的地形-高效多剂协作框架。 为了减少冗余的交流,我们引入了不同的节点穿刺,去掉临床上无关紧要的专家, 和不同的边缘穿刺,保留诊断上重要的连接。 对医疗VQA基准的广泛实验表明,MedPrune始终取得了较高的诊断性能和象征性效率。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Despite the promising results achieved by MedPrune , our work has several limitations that warrant further investigation.
(1) The configuration of our sparsification framework involves several key hyperparameters, such as the node dropout rate α \alpha and the noise tolerance δ \delta .
Although we adopt a progressive pruning schedule and observe stable performance with the chosen settings, these values are not exhaustively optimized across all possible departmental compositions and imaging modalities.
The optimal pruning aggressiveness may vary depending on the diagnostic question’s complexity and the number of collaborating specialists, suggesting a need for more adaptive pruning schedules in future work.
(2) We introduce a simple and straightforward strategy in Appendix B.3 that selects candidate departments by relevance scoring using a frozen MLLM. This design provides a clean, lightweight baseline without introducing additional trainable components or complicating the pipeline. While effective, integrating department selection directly into reinforcement learning optimization could further streamline the workflow and reduce reliance on external ranking heuristics.
(3) While our framework scales effectively with up to 15 agents across 3 departments, we do not evaluate scenarios involving a much larger cohort of subspecialists.
Future work should investigate the scalability of heterogeneous node and edge sparsification in more granular clinical settings, where dozens of sub-specialty agents might be available, to stress-test the efficiency gains and ensure the policy gradient optimization remains tractable under expanded combinatorial action spaces.
blocks.zh:
尽管MedPrune取得了可喜的成果,但我们的工作有一些局限性,值得进一步调查。
(1) 我们的螺旋化框架的配置涉及几个关键的超参数,如节点辍学率α-α和噪音耐受性等。
虽然我们采用渐进式的排查时间表,并按所选的设置观察到稳定的性能,但这些数值并没有在所有可能的部门组成和成像模式中详尽地加以优化。
最佳的攻击性可能因诊断问题的复杂性和协作专家的人数而异,这表明需要在今后的工作中采取更适应性的调查时间表。
(2) 我们在附录B.3中引入一项简单而直截了当的战略,利用冻结的MLLM通过相关评分来选择候选部门。 这一设计提供了一个干净、轻量级的基准,但没有增加可训练部件或使管道复杂化。 将部门选择直接纳入强化学习优化虽然有效,但可进一步精简工作流程并减少对外部排名的依赖。
(3) 虽然我们的框架在3个部门的15名代理人员中具有有效的规模,但我们不评估涉及更多次级专家群体的情况。
今后的工作应调查在更颗粒性临床环境中多种节点和边缘孢子化的可伸缩性,因为那里可能有几十个分特异性制剂,以测试增效的压力,并确保在扩大的组合行动空间下,政策梯度优化仍然可以采用。

In Table 3 , we summarize the training datasets’ statistics for training and testing. (1) MIMIC-CXR Johnson et al. (2019) contains a large-scale chest radiograph dataset comprising 377,110 images.
Each image is associated with 14 pathology labels automatically extracted from corresponding free-text radiology reports Xia et al. (2024a) .
(2) IU-Xray Demner-Fushman et al. (2016) is a publicly available dataset comprising 3,996 radiology reports and 8,121 associated chest images.

blocks.en:
For evaluation, we report accuracy abbreviated as “Acc.” in classification tasks (i.e., IU-Xray and OmniMedVQA), where a response is correct only if it exactly matches the ground truth.
For the generative task in MIMIC-CXR, we compute “BLEU”, “ROUGE-L”, “BERT-F1”, and “METEOR” scores to comprehensively evaluate task performance.
BLEU measures n - gram overlap between a model’s response and a reference. ROUGE - L evaluates recall based on keyword or phrase overlap. BERT - F1 is the F1 score of BERTScore Zhang et al. (2020) , which harmonically averages precision and recall using pre - trained BERT embeddings to estimate semantic similarity. METEOR (Metric for Evaluation of Translation with Explicit ORdering) accounts for both fluency and semantics, offering a more flexible assessment Hartsock and Rasool (2024) .

对于评价,我们报告分类任务(即IU-Xray和OmniMedVQA)中的精度被简称为“Acc ” ,只有与地面真相完全吻合,答复才是正确的。
对于MIMIC-CXR的再生任务,我们计算出“BLEUU”、“ROUGE-L”、“BERT-F1”和“METEOR”的分数,以全面评价任务业绩。
BLEU度量n -克 模型的响应和引用相重叠. ROUGE - L根据关键词或短语重叠来评价召回. BERT - F1是BERTScore Zhang等的F1分数(2020),该分数使用预-训练有素的BERT嵌入来估计语义相似性,和谐地平均精度和回想. METEOR(用明确命令进行翻译评价的方法)对流利和语义都作了说明,提供了更灵活的评价Hartsock和Rasool(2024年)。

blocks.en: B.2 Baseline
blocks.zh: B.2 基线

blocks.en:
(1) Training-free Methods. For standard prompt engineering (SP), the input image and question are formatted into a prompt with a MLLM and the model predicts a final response.
Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting Wei et al. (2022) enhances medical VQA tasks by guiding the model to generate intermediate reasoning steps, improving interpretability and enabling complex clinical reasoning.
mRAG works can also enhance the medical reasoning ability of the model by retrieving external knowledge.
MMed-RAG Xia et al. (2025b) introduces a domain-aware retrieval mechanism, an adaptive retrieved contexts selection, and a provable RAG-based preference fine-tuning strategy.
MIRA Wang et al. (2025a) enhances the factual accuracy in MLLMs via a calibrated adjustment module and a medical multimodal RAG for better knowledge integration.
RULE Xia et al. (2024b) mitigates factual errors by calibrating retrieved context count and fine-tuning with preference data to balance knowledge utilization.
(2) Training-intensive Methods. LoRA Hu et al. (2022) performs parameter-efficient tuning by updating low-rank matrices while freezing pre-trained weights. QLoRA Dettmers et al. (2023) extends it with 4-bit quantization, greatly reducing memory usage while maintaining comparable model performance.
GRPO Shao et al. (2024) is a critic-free reinforcement learning algorithm for LLM fine-tuning, extending RLHF Ouyang et al. (2022) by replacing the value function with group-normalized relative rewards from sampled response groups.
(3) Multi-Agent Collaboration Methods. AdaCoMed Chen et al. (2025a) is an adaptive co-learning collaborative framework that combines medical single-modal large models and multi-modal small models via MoME Shen et al. (2024) . M 3 Prune Shao et al. (2025) is a multi-modal multi-agent hierarchical graph pruning framework that removes redundant edges to balance performance and token overhead efficiently.
MedAgent-Pro Wang et al. (2025c) uses a hierarchical diagnostic workflow with RAG guidelines and tool integration, enabling evidence - based medical diagnosis.
MMedAgent-RL Xia et al. (2025a) is an RL-based multi-agent model for medical collaboration, using curriculum learning and dynamic entropy to unify specialist decisions.
CARE Du et al. (2026) is an evidence-grounded agentic framework that decouples medical reasoning into coordinated specialist modules with a dynamic coordinator, improving both accuracy and clinical accountability on medical VQA benchmarks.
ARG-Designer † Li et al. (2026) formulates multi-agent communication topology design as autoregressive graph generation, building task-specific collaboration graphs from scratch rather than pruning predefined template graphs.
Since the original model only supports pure-text inputs, we adapt it for our multimodal medical task by replacing its native SentenceTransformer encoder Reimers and Gurevych (2019) with the vision-language encoder SigLIP Zhai et al. (2023) to jointly encode medical text and visual data.

blocks.en: B.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: B.3 执行细节

blocks.en:
(1) Backbone Models. We use Qwen3-VL (8B) Team (2025) , HuatuoGPT-Vision (7B) Wang et al. (2023) , and Qwen3.6-Plus (397B) Qwen Team (2026) as our backbones.
All experiments are running on one NVIDIA A100 GPU.
(2) Hyperparameters. Rounds T = 2 T=2 , graph samples K = 10 K=10 , learning rate η = 0.1 \eta=0.1 , noise tolerance δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 .
The training process consists of two stages including node pruning followed by edge pruning, each conducted on 40 instances. Node pruning rate α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 , initial edge pruning rate p ( 0 ) = 0.5 p^{(0)}=0.5 .
(3) Agent Configuration. For IU-Xray Demner-Fushman et al. (2016) , we adopt a configuration of 5 departments, each consisting of 1 chief physician and 2 regular doctors. For MIMIC-CXR Johnson et al. (2019) ,we employ 3 departments, each comprising 1 chief physician and 4 regular doctors. For OmniMedVQA Hu et al. (2024) , we use 3 departments, each with 1 chief physician and 2 regular doctors.
(4) Graph Initialization. Within each department, all agents are fully connected to facilitate intra-department communication.
For inter-department connections, only chief physicians are fully connected, while regular doctors remain confined to their respective departments.
A directed acyclic graph (DAG) sampling strategy is employed to ensure sequential communication.
(5) Candidate Department Set Construction via Relevance Scoring. Clinical triage is performed to assign patients to relevant departments based on their presenting symptoms, with complex cases potentially requiring involvement from multiple departments. In this paper, we define a set of 11 candidate departments covering the specialties present in the datasets: Respiratory Medicine, Cardiology, Endocrinology, Rheumatology, Thyroid and Breast Surgery, Orthopedics, Spinal Surgery, Pathology, Radiology, Neurology, and Ophthalmology. Given a multimodal question (i.e., query and image), Qwen3.6-Plus (397B) ranks these departments by relevance and filters out irrelevant ones, with the remaining departments serving as candidates for collaboration (optionally as a subset).
(6) Final Answer Aggregation. After T T rounds, a summarizing agent combines messages from all chief physicians to produce the final answer.

采用了定向循环图(DAG)取样策略,以确保相继通信。
(5) 候选部门通过相关性分数设定构建。 进行临床分诊,根据患者的表征,将患者分配到相关部门,复杂病例可能需要多个部门参与. 在本文中,我们界定了一组11个候选部门,涵盖数据集中的专业: 呼吸道医学,心脏病学,内分泌学,风湿学,甲状腺和乳房外科,矫形科,脊髓外科,病理学,放射学,神经学,和眼科. 鉴于一个多式问题(即查询和图像),Qune3.6-Plus(397B)通过关联性对这些部门进行排序,并过滤出无关部门,其余部门作为合作候选人(可选作为子集)。
(6) 最后回答汇总。 在T T 回合后,一个总结剂将所有首席医生的信息结合起来,生成最终答案.

blocks.en: B.5 Attack Agent Roles Description
blocks.zh: B.5 攻击代理角色说明

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figs. 10 and 11 , we design two types of adversarial attacks targeting agents.
During implementation, a normal agent is randomly replaced with an attack agent. • Input Prompt Attack : An adversarial agent that completely ignores information from other agents and relies solely on its prior knowledge to make decisions. • Response Prompt Attack : An adversarial agent that intentionally produces incorrect answers accompanied by highly misleading explanations, aiming to persuade other agents that these answers are correct.
blocks.zh:
如图10和图11所示,我们设计了两种针对特工的对抗攻击。
实施期间,会随机取而代之的是普通剂. • 输入即时攻击:一名对抗方代理人完全无视其他代理人提供的信息,完全依赖其先前的知识作出决定。 • 反应即时攻击:一名对抗方代理人故意作出错误的答复,同时作出误导性极大的解释,目的是使其他代理人相信这些答复是正确的。

blocks.zh: D.3 费用结果详细原因

blocks.en:
In Table 11 , we provide the comprehensive token consumption per instance.
We assess the computational cost by measuring the average token usage per question.
For precise computational cost accounting, we explicitly clarify that the counted input tokens cover agent role prompts, multi-round dialogue historical messages, as well as repeated image and question text embeddings passed to each specialist agent. We further specify that output tokens are calculated as the total sum of all generation tokens produced by every agent throughout all collaborative communication rounds.
blocks.zh:
在表11中,我们提供了每个实例的综合象征性消费。
我们通过衡量每个问题的平均象征性使用量来评估计算成本。
对于精确的计算成本核算,我们明确澄清,所统计的输入符包括代理角色提示,多轮对话历史信息,以及反复传递给每个专家代理的图像和问题文本嵌入. 我们进一步规定,产出符号是每个代理在所有合作通信回合中产生的所有代号的总和。

blocks.en:
Table 12 reports comprehensive training-side metrics, including GPU hours, peak VRAM, training epochs and training token consumption.
Most competitive multi-agent baselines require updating full graph topology, leading to substantial training costs.
In contrast, MedPrune freezes the entire vision-language backbone and only optimizes lightweight soft adjacency matrices via policy gradient, significantly reducing training resource consumption.
For fixed-template models that do not require training and only require calling APIs for simple multi-agent collaboration, our training cost is acceptable in real-world scenarios, while our inference cost yields far greater long-term benefits than these fixed-template models.
blocks.zh:
表12报告全面的培训侧度量,包括GPU时数、高峰VRAM、培训时代和培训象征性消费。
大多数具有竞争力的多剂基线需要更新完整的图表地形,从而产生大量培训费用。
相形之下,MedPrune冻结了整个视觉语言主干线,仅通过政策梯度来优化轻量级软接力矩阵,大幅降低培训资源消耗.
对于不需要培训的固定模式,而只需要召集API进行简单的多代理协作,我们的培训成本在现实世界情景中是可以接受的,而我们的推断成本产生的长期效益远大于这些固定模式。

blocks.en: Fig. 12 and 13 illustrate a case from the IU-Xray dataset, demonstrating the intra- and inter-departmental collaboration mechanism of MedPrune .
blocks.zh: 图12和图13举例说明了IU-Xray数据集的一个案例,显示了MedPrune的部内和部门间协作机制。

blocks.en:
Specifically, in the first discussion round, agents from Radiology and Respiratory Medicine jointly examine the chest X - ray. They conclude that there is no evidence of pleural effusion supported by several observable signs: (1) the bilateral costophrenic angles remain sharp and clear, (2) there is no blunting, no crescent-shaped shadows, and no lower-lung opacification.
Meanwhile, agents from Cardiology deem the question outside their specialty. They therefore abstain from making any judgment.
In the second round, agents from Radiology and Respiratory Medicine re - examine the image. They integrate prior intra - departmental opinions, the conclusions from the previous round, and inputs from other departments. They consistently reaffirm the absence of pleural effusion, again citing the clear costophrenic angles and the lack of characteristic signs. Their conclusion remains unchanged from the first round. Agents in the Cardiology department continue to abstain from participation.
After multiple rounds of discussion, the Radiology and Respiratory Medicine agents reach full consensus. They determine that the chest X - ray shows no pleural effusion. The final answer is no . The Cardiology department does not participate in this question.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,在第一轮讨论中,放射学和呼吸医学的特效联合检查了胸X-射线. 他们的结论是,没有证据表明几个可观测到的征兆支持了胸膜充血:(1) 双边成本偏振角度仍然尖锐而清晰;(2) 不存在钝化,再生形状的阴影;以及没有下垂的吸血.
与此同时,心脏病学的特工们认为这个问题超出了他们的专长. 因此,他们不作任何判断。
在第二轮中,放射学和呼吸医学的特效——检查图像. 它们综合了以前部门内部的意见、上一轮的结论以及其他部门的投入。 它们一再重申缺乏胸膜取出液,并再次以明显的成本角度和缺乏特征标志为例。 其结论与第一轮相比保持不变。 心脏病科的特工继续回避参与。
经过多轮讨论后,放射学和呼吸道医学代理人达成了充分共识. 它们确定胸X射线显示没有胸膜分泌. 最后的答案是没有。 心脏病科不参与这个问题。
